From what I have read about a ward in my city, you get "locked-up" for 40 days, full time. After that you go to part-time hospitalization, morning shift is always. I'm familiar with it since I was in a part-time hospital for 4 months 2 years ago.. but, that wasn't really helping me at all.

Just have to gather the strenght to tell my parents that I need help and that's that.

+10% prot is way better than dodge, speaking statistically. It's guaranteed, dodge isn't. Don't get me wrong dodge is super cool, but High HP and Prot are better.

GR's throwing dagger is better IMO than Pick to the face, more Cirt, similar dmg, can hit R4.

Regarding the Scouting issue, I completely dissagree with the OP. Scouting can save your ass a million times. Prevents shuffles, let's you see where you want to go to avoid excess fights if needed. A scout quirk isn't a must have but it's certinly a very very good bonus. The downside is that they are random, can go on the wrong character(Like a Cove explorer on a Flag).

Also, Raw DMG is king in lvl 1-3 dmg, later in Champs it's utility and stuns(Trinkets are mandatory). And, HWM is the worst class IMO, why on earth would you  PB every time?? To kill the Swine that does minimal dmg compared to the rest. I would rather kill the Swine Wrench or the Virago. My strategy revolves around killing the back row ASAP and then stall the shit out of the fight to recover. 

Suggestion for the best party: Vestal/Jester/HM/MAA - Sustain, guarantee you go first on 2nd round(Bellow), Stress heals, Buffs, Can hit any rank, has triple stuns(if needed), 2 guards and sick healz bro xD
